name: 18 Downtown Cafe & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Pithoragarh's #1-ranked restaurant on TripAdvisor (4.8/5, 16 reviews) — a 4th-floor rooftop on top of Hotel Manar overlooking the Soar Valley. Italian-Chinese-Indian menu cooked to a higher bar than the bus-stand line.
insider_tip: Go before sunset — the valley view is the unannounced reason to come. Reservations matter on weekends; the rooftop is small.
signature_address: 4th Floor, Hotel Manar, Link Road, Pithoragarh 262501

name: Mynah Restaurant
why_it_matters: Sits beneath Hotel 78 in Nagarkoti Complex — modern decor with regional stone flooring, billed as Chinese-Tibetan with Indian-continental crossover. One of the few places in town leaning genuinely Tibetan rather than Indo-Chinese sauce-on-everything.
insider_tip: Stick to the thukpa and momos — that's what the kitchen cooks best. The continental side gets mixed reviews.

name: Meghna Sweets & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Pithoragarh's oldest sweet-shop-and-restaurant on Simalgair Road, family-run with 50-plus years of trading. Locally credited as the first modern restaurant in the Soar Valley; the rasgulla counter is the morning anchor and the upstairs hall does multi-cuisine.
insider_tip: Buy bal-mithai-style sweets from the front counter for the road; full meals upstairs are slower but the thali is the value pick.
signature_address: Simalgair Road, Gandhi Nagar, Bazaar, Pithoragarh 262501

name: The Den — A Family Restaurant
why_it_matters: Bus-stand-side family restaurant in Rangoli Complex, opposite KMOU — 4.3/5 Zomato (367+ reviews), 4.2/5 Restaurant Guru (744+ reviews). The default place locals send anyone arriving on the overnight bus from Delhi.
insider_tip: Service runs fast at lunch and slows after 8pm when the dinner crowd from Bus Stand and Sport Stadium Road piles in — go early or book a table on the upper floor.
signature_address: Bus Stand, Rangoli Complex, KMOU, Pithoragarh 262501

name: SOM Bar & Cafe
area: Near UTC Roadways Bus Station, Siltham
why_it_matters: Opened in 2018 next to the UTC Roadways bus station — Pithoragarh's first proper bar-cafe combination. 400+ reviews on Restaurant Guru (4/5). The town's main licensed venue for a beer with dinner; pizza-and-naan menu spans both crowds.
insider_tip: It's a bar-cafe with a family side — the alcohol section is partitioned. Order the rara chicken with naan; the pizzas are good but not the reason to come.
signature_address: Near UTC Roadways Bus Station, Siltham, Pithoragarh 262501

name: Takana Teas
why_it_matters: Run by a women's self-help group inside Saras Mall — bamboo furniture, all-female staff, pocket-friendly menu of Kumaoni snacks. The most ethical place to break a hill-town walk and the easiest place in town to order a vegetarian sandwich without negotiating.
insider_tip: The besan halwa is a Kumaoni home-recipe rarely on commercial menus — order it with the red tea instead of a coffee. Closed mid-afternoon on some weekdays; check before walking up.
signature_address: Saras Mall, Jeewan Chandra Marg, Pithoragarh 262501

name: Cafe On The Rocks
why_it_matters: On the Chandak Road climb at Sikrani — a daytime cafe with the same Himalaya panorama you'd otherwise drive 3km further to Chandak ridge for. Newly listed on TripAdvisor, no public reviews yet but the Maa Ulka Devi temple route makes it a natural stop.
insider_tip: Combine it with a Maa Ulka Devi temple visit on the same morning — both are on Chandak Road and the cafe sits below the ridge. Check phone first; weekday-afternoon hours can be patchy.

name: KMVN Ulka Devi Tourist Rest House Restaurant
why_it_matters: The state-run KMVN (Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam) tourist rest house, operating since 1969, with an in-house multi-cuisine restaurant near Ulka Devi temple. The default fallback for trekkers staging Munsiyari / Kailash-Mansarovar route departures who want a cheap thali at a known address.
insider_tip: Walk-in diners are welcome even if you're not staying — but order the Kumaoni thali, not the continental side. 2km from the bus stand; auto-rickshaw is the easy way up.
signature_address: Ulka Devi TRH, Chandak Road, Pithoragarh 262501
